messages:
alice: Heads-up — planning to roll runtime v2.4.0 + router header-split in tonight's 00:00-02:00 UTC change window. Need API and Console pinned to v1.9.2 for the first 50% traffic slice.

bob: Ack. Do we have explicit rollback criteria? Kernel-batching telemetry looks flaky on long seqs.

carol: Rollback criteria: 95th p95 latency > 500ms for >5 minutes OR error rate >1% on gen endpoints. Also increased KV eviction rate >2x.

alice: Agreed. Adding canary plan: deploy 5% runtime -> monitor 15m -> 25% -> 50% -> full. Router header-split will first route 10% to new header, then 50. Console pinned for reads only.

dan: Who will run the pin/unpin? I can handle console pin/unpin. ops-shepherd will manage runtime pinning with deploy-bot.

ops-shepherd: I'll be online for the window. Deploy-bot, please schedule canary and attach metrics view.

deploy-bot: @ops-shepherd scheduled wave 'runtime-v2.4.0-canary' starting 1725807600. Canary steps: 5% -> 25% -> 50%. Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/sg/yr-runtime-canary

bob: Release notes link: https://docs.redwood/release/172580-v2.4.0 (contains kernel changes, header-split, KV cache adjustments). Add migration note about header name change.

carol: Important: API compatibility — add header alias 'x-rw-session' fallback to 'x-session' for 48h post rollout. We'll pin API to v1.9.2 and add runtime fallback logic.

alice: Noted. I'll update the release note and add a short blurb in the change window message. Also adding rollback playbook snippet:

alice: ```
# rollback steps
1) set router header routing back to 0% new header
2) deploy-bot rollback runtime -> v2.3.7
3) unpin console (if pinned) and route all to v1.9.2
4) notify #incidents + oncall
```

dan: +1. If we hit KV eviction spike, rollback immediately. Ops will also temporarily increase cache TTLs.

ops-shepherd: Will run pinned handback at 01:30 UTC if stable. If any of the rollback triggers hit, I will hit the rollback command and coordinate with runtime team.

alice: OK. Final checklist: API pin + alias, Console pin handled by Dan, Deploy-bot schedule (ops-shepherd), release notes updated, dashboards pre-opened. Anyone object?

bob: No objections. I'll standby monitoring p95 and error rates.

carol: Good to go. :shipit:

alice: Thanks all — I'll post final window note 45min before. (cc @deploy-bot @ops-shepherd)
